text:
olivia: opened a docs PR to tidy the Praxis-13B model card + migration guide. main goals: replace external bench links, standardize naming, update SDK snippet to v4 async, and add provenance note. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4310 :wave:

dan: saw the preview. linkcheck failed. broken assets: /assets/bench/praxis/throughput.csv and an old weights URL on storage.redwood.ai.

infra-bot: linkcheck: 2 broken links found (docs/model-sources.md#L7, /assets/bench/praxis/throughput.csv). Recommendation: copy bench assets to docs/assets/bench/praxis, avoid absolute weight URLs; use a provenance block linking to upstream and license.

jason: i'll move the throughput CSV into docs/assets/bench/praxis and update the card links. ETA today.

priya: SDK note 12; current snippet uses the older sync client and expects resp['text']. update to v4 async and new response shape. small suggested snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = await client.generate(model="praxis-13b", prompt="Summarize: ...")
text = resp['choices'][0]['message']['content']
print(text)
```

olivia: thanks priya 12; i'll include that snippet in the PR. also planning to add a short provenance paragraph (upstream model page + license) and remove the direct weights link.

dan: casing inconsistency: card sometimes says 'Praxis-13B' and examples use 'praxis13b'. runtime aliases tolerate both but customers hit hyphen mismatches. normalize to display name and add an "aliases" line listing common runtime names.

priya: for migration guide, include YAML pin example showing alias vs display name: ```yaml
routes:
  - model: Praxis-13B
    aliases: [praxis13b, praxis-13b-int8]
    pinned_variant: praxis13b-int8
```

jason: adding a measurement methodology subsection: sequence_length=1024, batch=8, batch_window=200ms, runner args used, and hardware. will annotate the bench table with those units.

infra-bot: deploy-preview built. linkcheck: 1 broken link remains: https://storage.redwood.ai/models/praxis/weights.tar.gz referenced from docs/model-sources.md.

olivia: i'll remove the absolute weight URL from model-sources.md and point readers at the provenance block in the card.

jason: pushed CSV into docs/assets/bench/praxis and flipped the local links. also added the methodology subsection and clarified tokens/sec units. CI running.

doc-bot: CI passed. linkcheck clean. preview URL: https://deployments.preview.redwood.ai/docs/praxis-13b-card

olivia: merging once CI green. thanks everyone 14; will follow up with a separate issue to add streaming SDK examples and a template lint for alias fields. :rocket:
